# LinkedIn Technical Marketing Post: Cart Recovery Intent Intelligence

Behavioral telemetry engine that diagnoses why shoppers abandon carts (shipping sticker shock vs card decline vs distraction) and triggers dynamic 1-click rescue offers.

### The Problem
Most companies lose thousands in hidden operational waste every single month.

### The Engineered Fix
We engineered a zero-dependency system to solve this.

👉 Try the live interactive simulator here:
https://gideonbawa-website.netlify.app/simulators/cart-recovery-intelligence/

#SoftwareEngineering #Automation #SystemsArchitecture #BuildInPublic
